## Governing Issue
Closes #

## Summary
Describe what changed and why in one or two plain-language sentences.

## Scope boundary
State what this change deliberately does not change.

## Acceptance criteria evidence
- [ ] Criterion: quote one specific acceptance criterion that is now satisfied
  - Evidence: point to a test, changed file, check result, or observed behavior that proves it

## Verification
- Changed paths:
  - list every changed repository-relative path exactly as shown in GitHub's Files changed tab
- Commands/checks run: name the actual commands and whether they passed
- Exact head SHA verified: paste the current 40-character PR head SHA here
- Check results for that SHA: name each configured required check and its result for this exact SHA

## Risks and blockers
- Security/permissions impact: state which trust boundary or permission changed, or explicitly say none changed
- Known blockers: list any blockers, or explicitly say none are known
- Recovery or rollback: explain how to disable or back out this change

## Handoff
- Latest reviewer instructions addressed: summarize latest feedback, or state this is the first review
- Next action and owner: say who should do what next
- [ ] No-op commit check completed
